pages.title: Hold a Pattern
pages.text: Making a gem sing is easy. Holding dozens of changes at once is tiring.$(br2)$(l)Focus is yours, and returns with rest.$() Intricate arrangements ask more of it. An overdrawn cast can finish, but you must $(l)recover completely$() before casting again.

pages.title: The Current Within
pages.text: A pattern cannot stir on its own. It draws aether from your carried jars to place matter, move bodies or strike.$(br2)$(l)An empty jar will not fill itself.$() Check your reserves before leaving, or follow a resonance branch back to the workshop.

pages.title: A Spell That Misses
pages.text: A missed target cannot return all the force already released.$(br2)$(l)A miss refunds only part of the unused aether, never focus.$() The core records a basic cast. Leave more room for additional targets.

pages.title: Working It Out
pages.text: The figures from repeated experiments are kept in $(l:resource_costs)Working Notes$(/l). Turn there when you want to compare two arrangements precisely.
